preconditions.description: Input is a single integer n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly 2n integers (n lines, each with 2 coordinates).

postconditions.expression: all(x != y for x, y in zip(coords, coords[1:])) and all(x != z for x, y in coords for z, w in coords if (x, y) != (z, w))
postconditions.description: All output coordinates are unique (no duplicates).
The final number of knights (after all placements) is at least floor(n²/10).
